meteorCloud.title: MeteorCloud
meteorCloud.shortDescription: Multi-tenant ERP frontend for distribution companies, built with Next.js 15 and TypeScript, featuring inventory, sales, purchasing, and accounting management.
meteorCloud.description: Frontend for a multi-tenant ERP built for distribution companies (accounting, inventory, sales/purchase orders, warehouses, reports, user and permission management).
meteorCloud.stack: Next.js 15 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript, TailwindCSS v4 + shadcn/ui (Radix), SWR for data fetching, React Hook Form + Zod for forms, @tanstack/react-table for data tables, next-intl for i18n (English/Spanish), TipTap for rich text editing, dnd-kit for drag & drop, Recharts for graphical reports, jsPDF for PDF export.
meteorCloud.architecture: Pure client for an external REST API built in Golang with a PostgreSQL database. Two-layer authentication system (global session token + per-tenant access token), route gating and granular resource/action permissions, and a consistent "service → schema/type → hook → component" pattern replicated across 30+ CRUD entities. Version-controlled with Git and GitHub, working under an agile (Scrum) methodology.
meteorCloud.scope: 15+ operational modules (accounting, inventory, sales, purchases, stock transfers, master data, reports, users/roles, settings), with CSV import/export, per-tenant custom fields, an activity/audit feed, and multi-language support.

galoo.title: Galoo
galoo.shortDescription: Multi-tenant veterinary clinic SaaS, built with Next.js 16 + Express/TypeORM, featuring medical records, appointment scheduling, and a digital pet ID.
galoo.description: Multi-tenant veterinary clinic management SaaS: complete medical records, appointment scheduling, client communication via a digital pet ID, and clinic/staff administration.
galoo.stack: Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript, TailwindCSS v4 + shadcn/ui (Radix), React Hook Form + Zod for forms, react-big-calendar for scheduling, and Sonner for UI notifications. Custom backend in Express + TypeScript + TypeORM (PostgreSQL on Supabase), JWT authentication via httpOnly cookie, AWS S3 for medical files, and push notifications (Web Push/PWA) with an internal cron for reminders.
galoo.architecture: Monorepo with independent backend and frontend; the frontend consumes the API through a same-origin proxy (keeps the session cookie first-party, with no tokens exposed to the client). Layered backend (routes → controllers → services → TypeORM repositories) with real multi-tenancy (isolation by clinic, roles, and a superadmin), a polymorphic data model for clinical tracking (checkups nested under a consultation, surgery, or hospitalization), and a per-clinic feature-gating system built for 6 premium modules (inventory, advanced hospitalization, grooming, lab, advanced administration, and multi-branch).
galoo.scope: 15+ operational areas: patients, customers, scheduling/appointments, preventive medicine (vaccination, deworming, flea/tick treatment, each with its own product catalog), general consultations, surgeries, hospitalization with vital-signs monitoring, nutrition (food catalog and nutritional assessment), medical files, reminders and notifications (including push/PWA), a public digital pet ID via token, staff and role management, and multi-clinic administration.

About.title: About
About.paragraph1: I'm a frontend developer specialized in building modern, scalable web applications using React and Next.js. I have experience working on production systems including ERP/CRM platforms, booking applications, and management dashboards with role-based workflows.
About.paragraph2: I'm especially interested in the user experience side of frontend development. When building features, I focus not only on implementation but also on usability, user flows, and how interfaces can feel clear and intuitive.
About.paragraph3: I enjoy creating clean, maintainable architectures, working with backend APIs, and continuously improving the quality and reliability of the applications I build.
